title: ContributorReflexiveView
description: The contributor-reflexive facing — 'how the network sees a contributor'. Assembles engagement-accrued scalars (off the ContributorPresence row) with network-routed recognition folded from economic_events and the steward-role rollup from active stewardship_allocations. Operational Category C — read projection, no DHT entry.

presenceState.description: Claim lifecycle: unclaimed / stewarded / claimed (storage also: claiming).

recognitionScore.description: Engagement-accrued recognition score — assembled off the presence row, not re-folded.

totalRecognitionValue.description: Sum of resource_quantity_value across the presence's economic_events (network-routed recognition).

recognitionByAction.description: Recognition value bucketed by REA action, summed per action (deterministic order).

distinctContentRecognized.description: Count of distinct content nodes that routed recognition to this contributor.

commonsFlowValue.description: Recognition value visibly routed via the commons (receiver == 'commons-pool'). PARTIAL — settlements carry no contributor_presence_id; full commons accounting is a separate query.

stewardAllocationCount.description: Number of active stewardship allocations this presence holds.

stewardRecognitionAccumulated.description: Sum of recognition_accumulated across this presence's active stewardship allocations.
